visualReview.notes: Inspected all seven final portable views against four individually viewed local 2008–2010 museum, bar, lower-range and road-frontage originals. Five-window slate-hung main range, twin chimneys, perpendicular granite museum wing, eaves dormers and gabled entrances remain distinct. Review corrected shallow dormers, overly uniform stonework and the lower-range entrance.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all seven final shared-material views including the footprint overlay and full front. Granite, roof slate and timber use shared metric surfaces; slate-hung wall cladding and glass are separate local materials. Flat ground is a material fixture; portable views retain independent terrain.

mediumFiReview.notes: All19actual current version2context frames inspected against the exact cleared reference photographs. Noon/late,economy/high,full/detail/silhouette and all four forced levels retain the full exterior hierarchy, openings, entrance, roof masses and native mapped envelope. No embedded image pixels. The named photographer brianp3d CC0courtyard view confirms the granite museum/stables range, long hipped rag-slate roof, four low eaves dormers with paired left opening, gabled entrance porch, dark divided windows and low connector to the slate-clad bar visible along the right side. Current model preserves those proportions, opening hierarchy, perpendicular courtyard relationship and physical slate/stone/timber surfaces. The full fixed historic inn envelope is retained: five-window bar, twin axial stacks, museum range, attached rear range and low historic east connector. The main bar front and twin stacks are supported by the already recorded HistoricEngland architectural description; the photo crops that front. Hidden rear elevations, roof joins, heights, exact masonry, chimney details and low connector openings remain conservative mapped/description-led medium-fi estimates. Full exterior accepted at the agreed approximate scope, without signs, temporary furniture or interiors. Modern long east hotel/far rear service wings remain outside the original scope. Original map, terrain and placement are unchanged.
